name: stratified_gaussian_copula_rank_pairing
dependence_parameter_status: Author-selected working assumption, not estimated or identified by either supplied study.
primary_law: Within each cell, pair the supplied marginal grids using a Gaussian copula with latent correlation 0.85. Assign midpoint normal scores to ascending right-hand ranks, add independent normal innovations with conditional SD sqrt(1-rho^2), and assign ascending left values according to the resulting latent left ranks.
marginal_policy: Preserve every supplied right and left value exactly. Do not rescale, truncate, simulate measurement attempts, or mix cells.
stratum_weighting: Four equally weighted sex/age strata, as specified for the virtual study.
hand_definition: Anatomical right and left; each supplied value represents a person's mean over repeated attempts.
randomness: NumPy default_rng(seed), with independent normal innovations across rows and cells.
finite_grid_interpretation: Rank-reordering approximation to the population Gaussian copula, conditional on fixed marginal grids. Finite-sample rank correlations fluctuate and need not equal their population value.
